ask.text: The count stamped on the collar.

hints.text: Two pans across the Sill, and a deck that still has to reach.
Load both decks at the same value and see which one comes up short.
The bundle holds 9 of fixed weight, and 5 of it reaches the far end.

worldFraming.text: Two decks of different shape over one gap. Only the ones that carry every load get the same plaque.
